title: Two Mothers Holding Babies Outdoors, 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid outdoor black and white vintage snapshot from the around 1950 showing two women smiling as they hold young babies in their arms. Both women are bundled up in heavy winter overcoats, standing on a lawn in front of a rural house or farm building. The image features a deckled border characteristic of mid-20th-century family photography prints.
